changed_dimension: Serialize the same question and all passage fields as labeled plain text instead of a JSON user message. System instructions, model, output schema, retrieval, token budget and review rules unchanged.
adaptation: Course context construction uses labeled textual fields. This project retains every canonical provenance field and exact passage text; actual messages are recorded and verified independently of canonical context serialization.
hypothesis: Plain labeled passages may make source text and the question easier for the small model to use than nested JSON fields.
acceptance: Both answerable cases require complete source-supported answers; the unsupported-premise case requires bounded abstention without unsupported prose. No critical regression. Only a passing focused diagnostic justifies the broader six-slice pilot; no direct promotion.
rejected_alternatives: Remove provenance fields to reduce tokens
Use oracle reference passages as application retrieval
Change both context format and system instructions
tradeoffs: Human-readable field boundaries may aid use but are less formally separated than JSON
No metadata is discarded; source identities remain long and may still be copied incorrectly
Source text remains untrusted data under unchanged instructions
heldout_exposure: Explicit development cases only; no final inference or guaranteed blindness.
next_action: Address the repeatedly observed long source-version/passage-ID confusion with request-local short citation aliases, retaining exact canonical source/quote validation and evaluating semantic quality separately.
regressions: All three plain-context outputs are invalid; no complete answer improvement
